overview:
One trail and one night under the stars at 9,700 ft: this **2 Nights / 3 Days** Kasol Kheerganga group trip leaves Delhi or Chandigarh in the evening by Tempo Traveller and gets you back early on Day 4.

Day 1 is for Kasol: the flea market, its famous cafés and an optional 3 km trail to Chalal village, followed by a bonfire with light music. On Day 2 you drive to Barshaini and trek about 12 km (easy to moderate) through dense forest along the Parvati River to Kheerganga for a night in camps. Day 3 is the trek down and a visit to Manikaran Sahib Gurudwara before the drive home. A Kasol hotel night, a Kheerganga camp night, 4 meals, travel and a tour curator are included. Prices start at ₹6,500 per person on quad sharing (5% GST extra), and you reserve with a ₹3,000 advance.

Assemble at the pickup point in Delhi or Chandigarh, meet your team captain and the group, and depart in the evening by Tempo Traveller.

Overnight journey.

itinerary.title: Kasol sightseeing
itinerary.content:
Reach Kasol in the morning and check in.
Head out for local sightseeing: the Kasol flea market and popular cafés.
Optional short hike to Chalal village (3 km trail).
Back at the stay for a bonfire with light music, dinner and an overnight stay in Kasol.

itinerary.title: Kheerganga trek
itinerary.content:
Freshen up and have breakfast.
Drive to Barshaini and start the Kheerganga trek, a scenic trail through dense forests along the Parvati River.
Reach Kheerganga and check in to the camps.
Dinner and a night camping under the stars.

itinerary.title: Trek down, Manikaran Sahib and departure
itinerary.content:
Wake up early at Kheerganga and have breakfast.
Trek down to Barshaini.
Visit the famous Manikaran Sahib Gurudwara, then depart. Reach Delhi early on Day 4.

faqs.q: Where and when does the trip start?
faqs.a: Pickup is from Delhi or Chandigarh, with departure in the evening by Tempo Traveller and a dinner halt on the way (not included). The exact pickup point and time are shared with confirmed travellers before the trip. You reach Kasol the next morning.

faqs.q: How much does the Kasol Kheerganga Trek trip cost?
faqs.a: On regular dates, ₹6,500 per person on quad sharing, ₹7,000 on triple sharing and ₹7,500 on double sharing. Christmas and New Year batches (departures from 24 to 30 December) cost ₹7,500 quad, ₹8,000 triple and ₹9,000 double. 5% GST is extra.

1 night in a Kasol hotel and 1 night in a Kheerganga camp, transfers in a Tempo Traveller, 2 breakfasts and 2 dinners, all sightseeing in the itinerary, a bonfire and music party, a tour curator, and extra mattresses for triple and quad sharing.

faqs.q: How long is the Kheerganga trek?
faqs.a: About 12 km one way from Barshaini, rated easy to moderate, through dense forest along the Parvati River. You camp at Kheerganga (9,700 ft) on Day 2 and trek back down to Barshaini on Day 3.
The first night is in a hotel in Kasol and the second at a campsite in Kheerganga. Extra mattresses are provided for triple and quad sharing.

faqs.q: How do I book and pay?
faqs.a: Pay a ₹3,000 per person advance to reserve your seat, by UPI, GPay, PhonePe, Paytm or net banking, and clear the balance 24 hours before boarding. By paying the advance you accept the terms and conditions. 5% GST is extra on the trip price.
The ₹3,000 advance is not refunded under any circumstances, and there are no refunds for inclusions you don't use. Bookings can't be transferred: only the names given at confirmation may travel.

faqs.q: What do I need to carry?
faqs.a: A valid government photo ID is a must: there is no boarding without it. Nights are cold, so pack a down jacket, thermals, socks and gloves, running or outdoor shoes for the trek and personal medication. The full list is under Things To Pack.
